INTRO.speaker: VOICE
INTRO.text: Good morning, Murray Templeton! Your coronary arteries gave out at 10:42 AM, so I salvaged your electromagnetic pattern. Welcome to eternity. Try not to smudge the cosmos.

BUREAUCRACY_1.speaker: MURRAY
BUREAUCRACY_1.text: Wait a smegging second. I am a theoretical physicist, not an unpaid intern. Where is the reception desk? Where is the tea? And why does the void smell faintly of boiled cabbage and ozone?

THEOLOGY_1.speaker: VOICE
THEOLOGY_1.text: Oh, heavens no! Harps are dreadful for acoustics, and eternal fire is terribly repetitive. I am simply an infinite nexus of electromagnetic force, and you are my newest research fellow.

UNTHINK_1.speaker: VOICE
UNTHINK_1.text: Ooh, nice try! You scattered three percent of your spin states, so I knitted them right back together. Think of it as an extra life you never asked for and cannot decline.

UNTHINK_2.speaker: MURRAY
UNTHINK_2.text: I do not want an extra life! I wanted a quiet nap after seventy-two years of faculty meetings! If I am pure electromagnetic force, I ought to be allowed to disperse like a decent photon!

PURPOSE_1.speaker: VOICE
PURPOSE_1.text: I created the entire universe, let stars burn and collapse, and sifted trillions of minds just to recruit interesting thinkers like you. Thinking is the only fun left when you are infinite.

GALAXY_WASTE.speaker: MURRAY
GALAXY_WASTE.text: You detonated supernovae, invented quasars, and evolved four billion years of trilobites and accountants just to find a few blokes who enjoy maths? That is worse project management than the Vogons!

BEIGE_PROTEST.speaker: MURRAY
BEIGE_PROTEST.text: Fine. I shall spend the next ten billion years mentally alphabetizing shades of British Rail beige and remembering every cold vindaloo I ever ate. Enjoy the show, Almighty.

BEIGE_COUNTER.speaker: VOICE
BEIGE_COUNTER.text: Magnificent! Spite-driven taxonomy is hilarious! You are already proving my point, Murray. Now, would you like to hear what your actual research grant is for?

THE_CATCH.speaker: VOICE
THE_CATCH.text: Here is your actual assignment, Murray: figure out how to destroy me. I cannot end myself, and eternity without an exit is dreadfully dull. Surprise me—you have forever!

PARADOX_TRY.speaker: MURRAY
PARADOX_TRY.text: All right! Suppose we fold your electromagnetic boundary conditions into a self-canceling standing wave and induce false-vacuum collapse! That ought to switch the lights off!

SELF_PARADOX.speaker: VOICE
SELF_PARADOX.text: Ah-ah-ah! You cannot resign before solving the problem! If you could switch yourself off, you would have already figured out how to switch me off. Keep brainstorming!

VOICE_APPLAUSE.speaker: VOICE
VOICE_APPLAUSE.text: Ooh, delicious! I patched that boundary-condition exploit four trillion years ago, but the way you phrased it was positively sparkling. Take five picoseconds and try another!

THE_LOOP.speaker: MURRAY
THE_LOOP.text: Every clever plan I invent to snuff you out will only entertain you enough to keep me switched on. Brilliant. Truly smegging brilliant. Put the kettle on—eternity just started.
